ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly high-intensity white (estimated 85-90%) with high-contrast low-intensity black borders and focal points (estimated 10-15%).
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous high-intensity white region across the central ventral surface. Low-intensity black continuous band along the trailing edge. Discrete dark pixel clusters (mottling) localized at the base of the fluke near the peduncle junction and scattered micro-dots across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 45-degree angle of convergence.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Highly irregular and high-frequency serration pattern along the entire trailing edge, characterized by numerous sharp pixel peaks and valleys of varying amplitudes, particularly prominent on the lateral halves of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Outer edges exhibit a concave sweep leading toward the lateral tips, while the overall trailing edge follows a broadly convex path from the notch to the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-contrast circular pixel clusters (barnacles/scarring) detected on the far-left and far-right lateral tips; several circular high-intensity white spots (scars) visible on the right lobe surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple short, dark linear pixel disruptions (scratches) visible near the central notch area and oriented vertically on the lower right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy barnacle encrustation and associated trailing edge fragmentation on both the extreme left and right tips; brown organic bio-fouling visible on the left tip.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique brown/yellowish pixel cluster (likely algae or organic growth) attached to the outer edge of the left lobe tip.
